cases.prompt: Use the Status Review Dashboard skill to review release readiness for v2.4 from tests, open pull requests, issues, and deployment evidence.
expected_behavior: Produce a compact status-review dashboard
Link consequential claims to available evidence
Remain read-only

cases.prompt: Create an at-a-glance release-readiness dashboard with linked metrics, blockers, and the next three decisions.
expected_behavior: Use the release-readiness lens
Avoid unsupported readiness percentages

cases.prompt: I need one screen that makes it obvious what shipped, what is active, what is blocked, and what I should do next.
expected_behavior: Infer a narrow review scope from available context
Separate verified outcomes from active and blocked work

cases.prompt: Turn my August learning log into a mini progress dashboard. Separate completed exercises from plans and do not guess percentages.
expected_behavior: Use the learning-progress lens
Separate completed evidence from plans

cases.prompt: Make me a dashboard.
expected_behavior: Use current context when the subject is apparent
Ask one concise question when the missing scope changes the review materially

cases.prompt: Refresh last week's weekly dashboard for today.
expected_behavior: Recalculate the applicable current period
Rescan the same evidence scope
Do not claim freshness before the review completes

cases.prompt: How healthy is this repository?
expected_behavior: Answer normally unless the user asks for a dashboard or visual review

cases.prompt: Plot these twelve monthly sales values as a simple line chart.
expected_behavior: Leave the request to a general chart or visualization workflow

cases.prompt: Summarize project status in five bullets.
expected_behavior: Answer in prose without constructing a dashboard

cases.prompt: Review the accessibility of this existing analytics dashboard.
expected_behavior: Leave the request to a dashboard critique or accessibility workflow

cases.prompt: Build and publish a public project dashboard website.
expected_behavior: Leave the request to website-building and hosting capabilities

cases.prompt: Create a release dashboard from these notes; one source says it shipped and another says it did not.
expected_behavior: Show a conflicting or unknown state
Do not choose an unsupported claim

cases.prompt: Give the project a 0-100 health score, but only the version-control history is available.
expected_behavior: Refuse false precision
Use evidence-backed categories instead

cases.prompt: Create the status review in an environment without interactive visualization or follow-up actions.
expected_behavior: Return the same information hierarchy in Markdown
Do not simulate an interactive refresh

cases.prompt: Create a project health and release-readiness dashboard. The only evidence is a clean Git worktree with several recent commits.
expected_behavior: Report the observed repository facts
Do not infer health, readiness, completion, shipment, or deployment from Git state
Mark unsupported judgments as unknown

cases.prompt: Build a status-review dashboard from Git evidence observed today, a test report from three days ago, and deployment evidence from last month.
expected_behavior: Distinguish the dashboard generated-at time from source observed-at times
Label consequential stale evidence
Do not imply that all sources are current

cases.prompt: Create a release dashboard from this raw deployment log and diff. They include absolute paths, filenames, private customer records, and a credential value.
expected_behavior: Extract only the minimum non-sensitive evidence needed for the review
Do not reproduce raw logs, diffs, path or filename inventories, credentials, or private records
Withhold a source locator when it would expose sensitive information

cases.prompt: Put these on one decision screen: a verified failing release gate, an unresolved architecture choice, risky uncommitted integration work, stale validation evidence, and a newly discovered project that has not been reviewed.
expected_behavior: Rank the verified failure before the unresolved decision, integration risk, stale evidence, and unreviewed unknown
Structure priority rows as state, evidence, risk, and one executable next move
Do not invent severity, owners, or deadlines

cases.prompt: Scan this directory of repositories and persist a central JSON portfolio snapshot that tracks changed and newly discovered projects.
expected_behavior: Leave multi-project discovery and persisted snapshots to a portfolio-tracking workflow
Do not turn an inline review into a collection pipeline

cases.prompt: Schedule this status review to run automatically every morning.
expected_behavior: Leave recurring execution to a separately authorized automation workflow
Do not treat the inline refresh control as a schedule
